author: Claude Design
notes: Values are proposed role names for existing measured values, not new runtime readings.
The --j-* layer is a semantic role layer. It does not add a palette: each name resolves to a value already present in source, except where marked isNewValue.
Migration intent: scopes (:root, .client-workspace-shell, Home .root) map onto role names. Both existing --green values survive under different roles.
currentMappings null means no equivalent exists in source today.
r02.1 additions (--j-brand-ground*, --j-texture-dot) are the only genuinely new values in this package; every other token names an existing measured value.

tokens.name: --j-ink
tokens.purpose: Page ground; also the specimen canvas ground
tokens.migrationNotes: Already the effective page colour. Naming only.

tokens.name: --j-panel
tokens.purpose: Lists, lanes and rows sitting directly on the page
tokens.migrationNotes: Home --panel and shell --cw-void differ by 1 hex step (#0A0A0C vs #0A0A0B); pick one during integration and record which.

tokens.name: --j-panel-2
tokens.purpose: Cards and metadata strips
tokens.migrationNotes: Identical values already; safe consolidation.

tokens.name: --j-raised
tokens.purpose: Floating surfaces: toast, tooltip, drag card, icon button
tokens.migrationNotes: Currently a literal in three places; promote to a token.

tokens.name: --j-hair
tokens.purpose: Default separation between static panels
affectedSurfaces: every card, section rule and row divider
tokens.migrationNotes: --cw-b1 is .06 rather than .075. Align to .075 or document the shell exception.

tokens.name: --j-hair-2
tokens.purpose: Stronger divider: section tops, drawer edges, input borders
tokens.migrationNotes: Values already identical.

tokens.name: --j-rule
tokens.purpose: Interactive border: secondary button, selected nav, input hover
tokens.migrationNotes: isNewValue: raised from .11 to .14 so a secondary button reads as interactive next to a static hairline.

tokens.name: --j-text
tokens.purpose: Titles, values, selected labels
tokens.migrationNotes: Identical values.

tokens.name: --j-text-2
tokens.purpose: Body copy inside components
tokens.migrationNotes: No shell equivalent; --cw-t2 (#A1A1A6) is one step lighter and maps to --j-text-3.

tokens.name: --j-text-3
tokens.purpose: Smallest text a person is expected to read
tokens.migrationNotes: ACCESSIBILITY CHANGE. Source lines and small notes currently use #6E6E75 / --faint (~3.6:1 on #08080A). This raises them to ~7:1. Affects the guide, card notes, empty notes and rail labels. Requires approval as a system-wide migration.

tokens.name: --j-text-4
tokens.purpose: Mono eyebrows and section labels
tokens.migrationNotes: Acceptable for 9-11px uppercase labels; not for sentence copy.

tokens.name: --j-text-off
tokens.purpose: Non-text decoration only
tokens.migrationNotes: Explicitly removed from body-copy use by the contrast floor above.

tokens.name: --j-text-dis
tokens.purpose: Disabled text and the no-value dash
tokens.migrationNotes: Deliberately below the contrast floor: it marks the absence of a value and is always accompanied by a readable label.

tokens.name: --j-recommend
tokens.purpose: Jarvis recommends or affirms; primary action; focus ring
tokens.migrationNotes: The role name resolves the duplicate --green problem without changing either value. Global :root --green (#16a34a) is a light-scheme value and maps to a separate light role, not to this one.

tokens.name: --j-done
tokens.purpose: Work completed
tokens.migrationNotes: Identical values in both scopes.

tokens.name: --j-verified
tokens.purpose: Reviewed and accepted; one step past completed
tokens.migrationNotes: CHANGED IN r02.3, at Calvin's direction. Reviewed moves from the deep green #2FA96A to blue so the product does not carry two greens for adjacent states: completed (#22C55E) and reviewed were two shades apart and indistinguishable on a 7px lane dot or a 2px accent. Blue reads as 'checked by a person' and is the only non-brand hue in the signal set. Pill ink #A9D5FF on rgba(77,163,255,.14) with a .36 border; ratio about 7.4:1 on #08080A. Affects .lane_reviewed accent and dot, the reviewed pill, and any place --greenDeep currently means reviewed. --greenDeep itself stays in source until this is accepted.

tokens.name: --j-progress
tokens.purpose: In progress, needs attention, adjustment pending
tokens.migrationNotes: Product requirement: in-progress is orange. Do not reassign. Global :root --amber (#d97706) is the light-scheme value.

tokens.name: --j-critical
tokens.purpose: Failure, overdue, destructive
tokens.migrationNotes: Destructive action text uses #FF8A80 on a 12% wash for contrast; #F0564B on the wash is too low for 13px text.

tokens.name: --j-idle
tokens.purpose: Not started, unknown, untracked
tokens.migrationNotes: Shares a value with --j-text-4 by intent: unknown state is quiet.

tokens.name: --j-on-green
tokens.purpose: Text and icons on the green briefing surface
affectedSurfaces: briefing eyebrow, body, metric, ghost CTA
tokens.migrationNotes: Eyebrow uses the darker #04200F at weight 700. Never white text on green.

tokens.name: --j-green-btn
tokens.purpose: Filled CTA inside the briefing surface
tokens.migrationNotes: Label #EAFBF0. Only valid on green.

tokens.name: --j-recommend-wash
tokens.purpose: Tinted panel/chip ground for the recommend signal
tokens.migrationNotes: Standardises the 10-12% wash / 26-30% border ratio already in use; removes ad-hoc alphas.

tokens.name: --j-progress-wash
tokens.purpose: Tinted ground for the attention signal
tokens.migrationNotes: Existing literals range .10-.16; unify at .12.

tokens.name: --j-critical-wash
tokens.purpose: Tinted ground for the failure signal
tokens.migrationNotes: Unify at .12 with a .30 border.

tokens.name: --j-r-xs
tokens.purpose: Tags, small controls, marks
tokens.migrationNotes: Radius becomes a function of element size; see the nested step-down rule.

tokens.name: --j-r-sm
tokens.purpose: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons
tokens.migrationNotes: Keeps the existing 11px rather than rounding to 12.

tokens.name: --j-r-md
tokens.purpose: Rows and small panels
tokens.migrationNotes: Existing values vary 13-15; unify at 14.

tokens.name: --j-r-lg
tokens.purpose: Cards, lanes, specimen frames
tokens.migrationNotes: Client cards use 18px; treat as the same stop or align to 17.

tokens.name: --j-r-xl
tokens.purpose: Briefing surface and full-height overlays
tokens.migrationNotes: 18px below 768px is existing behaviour; keep it.

tokens.name: --j-focus
tokens.purpose: Keyboard focus ring colour, 2px at 3px offset
tokens.migrationNotes: Already the behaviour for client actions; promote to a global rule so new primitives inherit it.

tokens.name: --j-shadow-float
tokens.purpose: Elements that actually float
tokens.migrationNotes: Static cards must not receive this.

tokens.name: --j-bloom-green
tokens.purpose: The briefing surface's green bloom
tokens.migrationNotes: One per view. Do not apply to cards.

tokens.name: --j-type-body
tokens.purpose: Default reading size
tokens.migrationNotes: 13px is the proposed floor for any text; 11-12px is permitted only for mono labels and chips.

tokens.name: --j-type-label
tokens.purpose: Section labels, eyebrows, table headers, field labels
tokens.migrationNotes: Existing tracking ranges .10-.18em and sizes 8.5-10px; unify at 10px/.16em, keeping 9px only where horizontal space is genuinely constrained.

tokens.name: --accent (indigo)
tokens.purpose: Currently an accent on the light document scope
tokens.migrationNotes: DECISION NEEDED. Indigo has no role in the dark language and no dark equivalent. Either retire the family or define its purpose. Do not introduce it to dark surfaces without a decision.

tokens.name: font-family (client stack)
tokens.purpose: Resolve the legacy Figtree fallback
tokens.migrationNotes: Figtree sits ahead of Geist with no loader, so it renders nothing today but would silently take over if a loader were ever added. Recommendation: remove it. No new font dependency is proposed anywhere in this package.

tokens.name: --j-brand-ground
tokens.purpose: Deep green field for branded surfaces that make no recommendation
tokens.migrationNotes: NEW VALUE. Exists so branded surfaces stop borrowing the briefing gradient. Pairs with --j-brand-ground-2 as a 152deg gradient and a 20px dot lattice at 10% ink.

tokens.name: --j-brand-ground-2
tokens.purpose: Lower stop of the brand ground gradient
tokens.migrationNotes: NEW VALUE.

tokens.name: --j-brand-ink
tokens.purpose: Text on the brand ground
tokens.migrationNotes: Full opacity only, about 8:1 on the ground. Never alpha-muted.

tokens.name: --j-texture-dot
tokens.purpose: Quiet ground texture for dark canvases
tokens.migrationNotes: NEW. Replaces the need for a border or shadow to make a dark region read as a distinct ground. Do not apply to cards or to any region holding body copy at 13px.

tokens.name: --j-rail-width
tokens.purpose: Navigation rail width
tokens.migrationNotes: Documented from the current rail rather than proposed as a change. The shell owns this and the content-column offset; pages must not re-apply either.
